title: The 2020 Calabrian regional election takes place.
text: The 2020 Calabrian regional election took place in Calabria, Italy, on 26 January 2020. The result was the victory of the centre-right coalition and the election of Jole Santelli as President of Calabria.

title: The 2020 Emilia-Romagna regional election takes place.
text: The 2020 Emilia-Romagna regional election took place in Emilia-Romagna, Italy, on 26 January 2020. The result was the victory of the centre-left coalition and the confirmation of Stefano Bonaccini as President of Emilia-Romagna, with more than 51% of votes, nearly doubling the number of votes received in 2014.

title: Italy's Senate votes to allow prosecutors to put Matteo Salvini on trial over charges of holding migrants at sea.
text: Matteo Salvini is an Italian politician serving as Deputy Prime Minister of Italy and Minister of Infrastructure and Transport since 2022. He has been Federal Secretary of Italy's Lega party since December 2013 and an Italian senator since March 2018.

title: The first outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic in Italy occurs in Codogno in Lombardy, with 14 confirmed cases.
text: Codogno is a town and comune of 15,868 inhabitants in the province of Lodi, Lombardy, northern Italy. It is the main center of the plain known as Basso Lodigiano, which has about 90,000 inhabitants.

title: Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte signs a decree to close all schools nationwide and activate a massive lockdown in northern Italy.
text: Giuseppe Conte is an Italian jurist, academic, and politician who served as prime minister of Italy from June 2018 to February 2021. He has been the president of the Five Star Movement (M5S) since August 2021.

title: The Italian basketball championship is officially ended due to the COVID-19 pandemic in Italy; Virtus Bologna becomes champion of Italy at the table.
text: Virtus Pallacanestro Bologna, known for sponsorship reasons as Virtus Costa Bologna, is an Italian professional basketball club based in Bologna, Emilia-Romagna. The club was founded in 1927, which makes it the oldest club in Italy and one of the oldest in Europe.

title: The member of the Chamber of Deputies Rosalba De Giorgi resigns from the Five Star Movement.
text: Rosalba De Giorgi is an Italian politician and journalist. She was a member of the Chamber of Deputies of the Italian Parliament from 2018 to 2022.

title: The Italian football championship Serie A resumes after the 2-month break due to the lockdown.
text: The Serie A, officially known as Serie A Enilive in Italy and Serie A Made in Italy abroad for sponsorship reasons, is a professional association football league in Italy and the highest level of the Italian football league system. title: Juventus wins the 2019-20 Serie A.
text: Juventus Football Club, commonly known as Juventus or colloquially as Juve (Italian: ), is a professional football club based in Turin, Piedmont, Italy. They compete in Serie A, the top tier of Italian football.

title: After ending support in the United States, Canada, the rest of Europe and China, the Nintendo 3DS together with the 2DS, 3DS XL, New 3DS, New 3DS XL and New 2DS XL versions end support in Italy, thus putting an end to the era of 3DS in the…
text: The Nintendo 3DS is a foldable dual-screen handheld game console developed and marketed by Nintendo. Announced in March 2010 and released beginning in early 2011, it succeeds the Nintendo DS and DSi.

title: The 2020 Campania regional election takes place; Vincenzo De Luca is elected as president of the Campania region.
text: The 2020 Campanian regional election took place in Campania on 20 and 21 September 2020. It was originally scheduled to take place on 31 May 2020, but it was delayed due to the COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

title: “Blun7 a Swishland” by Tha Supreme
text: "Blunt a Swishland" is a song by Italian rapper and record producer Tha Supreme. It was released on 8 November 2019 by Epic Records as fifth single from the artist's debut studio album 23 6451.

title: “Boogieman” by 17 January
text: "Boogieman" is a song by Italian rapper Ghali, with featured vocals by Salmo. It was released on 17 January 2020 as the second single of Ghali's second studio album DNA. The song peaked at number 1 of the Italian singles' chart and was certified double platinum.

title: “Calmo” by Shiva and Tha Supreme
text: "Calmo" is a song by Italian rapper Shiva featuring Tha Supreme. It was produced by Tha Supreme, and released on 23 January 2020 as the only single from Shiva's second EP Routine.

title: “Fai rumore” by Diodato
text: "Fai rumore" is a song written and performed by Italian singer Antonio Diodato. It was released as a single on 7 February 2020 and was featured on his album Che vita meravigliosa.

title: “Good Times” by Ghali
text: "Good Times" is a song by Italian rapper Ghali. It was produced by Merk & Kremont, and released on 3 April 2020 as the third single of Ghali's second studio album DNA. The song peaked at number 1 of the Italian singles' chart and was certified quadruple platinum.

title: “Bando” by Anna
text: "Bando" is the debut single by Italian rapper Anna. It was released by Virgin Records on 31 January 2020.

title: “Blinding Lights” by The Weeknd
text: "Blinding Lights" is a song by Canadian singer-songwriter the Weeknd, from his fourth studio album, After Hours. The song was released through XO and Republic Records on November 29, 2019, as the album's second single.

title: “Auto blu” by Shiva and Eiffel 65
text: "Auto blu" is a song by Italian rapper Shiva, which was released on 26 March 2020. It features a sample from "Blue (Da Ba Dee)" by Eiffel 65, who are credited as guest artists.

title: “Le feste di Pablo” by 10 April
text: "Le feste di Pablo" is a song by Italian singer Cara. It was written by Cara, Dargen D'Amico, Davide Simonetta, Paolo Antonacci, and produced by Simonetta and Sixpm.

title: “Pussy” by Dark Polo Gang and Tony Effe featuring Lazza and Salmo
text: Dark Polo Gang was an Italian trap musical group from Rome founded by Tony Effe, Side Baby, Wayne Santana and Dark Pyrex in 2014. Dark Polo Gang is known to have emerged to fame without the help or support of a major, having produced music tracks and video clips independently.

title: “Spigoli” by 15 May
text: "Spigoli" is a song by Italian singer-songwriter Carl Brave featuring Mara Sattei and Tha Supreme. It was released on 12 May 2020 as the third single from Brave's second studio album Coraggio.

title: “Mediterranea” by Irama
text: "Mediterranea" is a song by Italian singer-songwriter Irama. It was released on 19 May 2020 by Warner Music Italy as the second single from the second EP Crepe.

title: “M' manc”
text: "M' manc" is a song by Italian record producer Shablo with vocals by Italian rappers Geolier and Sfera Ebbasta. It was released by Island Records on 12 June 2020.

title: “Karaoke” by Boomdabash and Alessandra Amoroso
text: "Karaoke" is a song by Italian group Boomdabash and Italian singer Alessandra Amoroso. It was released on 11 June 2020 through Universal Music Italy, as the lead single from the group greatest hits album Don't Worry.

title: “A un passo dalla luna” by Rocco Hunt and Ana Mena
text: "A un passo dalla luna" is a 2020 Italian-language single of Italian rapper Rocco Hunt and Spanish singer Ana Mena released on 3 July 2020 on RCA and Sony. The song spent 9 weeks at the top of the Italian Singles Chart, being certified six platinum by FIMI. title: “Superclassico” by 25 September
text: "Superclassico" is a song written and recorded by Italian rapper Ernia. It was released on 19 June 2020 by Island Records as the lead single from his third studio album Gemelli.

title: “Altalene” by Bloody Vinyl, Slait and Tha Supreme featuring Mara Sattei and Coez
text: "Altalene" is a single by Italian rappers and producers Slait and Tha Supreme, released on 2 October 2020 as the sole single from the mixtape Bloody Vinyl 3. The track features guest vocals by Italian singers Mara Sattei and Coez.
listen: Altalene Bloody Vinyl, Slait and Tha Supreme featuring Mara Sattei and Coez

title: “Bottiglie privè” by Sfera Ebbasta
text: "Bottiglie privè" is a song by Italian rapper Sfera Ebbasta. It was released on 28 October 2020 by Island Records as the lead single for the artist's third studio album Famoso.

title: “Baby” by Sfera Ebbasta and J Balvin
text: "Baby" is a song by Italian rapper Sfera Ebbasta featuring Colombian singer J Balvin. It was released on 20 November 2020 by Island Records as the second single for Sfera Ebbasta's third studio album Famoso.

title: “All I Want for Christmas Is You” by Mariah Carey
text: "All I Want for Christmas Is You" is a song by American singer-songwriter Mariah Carey from her fourth studio album and first holiday album, Merry Christmas. She wrote and produced the song with Walter Afanasieff.
